name: migration-guard
description: Prevents editing database migrations that already exist; write a new one instead.

directories.title: Migration directories
directories.description: Comma-separated directory names (or paths) that hold migrations, matched anywhere in a file's path.

allowUncommitted.title: Allow uncommitted migrations
allowUncommitted.description: Also allow editing migrations that existed before the session but are not tracked in git yet. Tracked ones stay protected.
